summary: BetterLife Pharma Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Material Change Report regarding a CAD $2,000,000 convertible debenture financing closed on June 22, 2026. The debenture bears 10% interest, matures June 1, 2027, and is convertible at CAD $0.06 per unit (one share plus a warrant exercisable at CAD $0.10 for three years). A director-subscribed related-party transaction relies on exemptions under MI 61-101 as fair value is under 25% of market cap. Proceeds fund IND-enabling activities for BETR-001 and working capital. No special situation—this is a routine capital raise with a related-party participation exemption.
